termsScreen.title: Terms & Privacy
termsScreen.terms1Body: By creating an account or using Labbe, you agree to these Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy below. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.
termsScreen.terms2Body: Labbe is a marketplace that connects customers with independent home-service providers — cleaning, plumbing, electrical, AC, furniture assembly, TV mounting, and more. Providers are independent businesses, not employees or agents of Labbe.
termsScreen.terms3Body: You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Please provide accurate information when you sign up.
termsScreen.terms4Body: When you book a provider, you're entering into an agreement directly with that provider for the requested service. Labbe facilitates the booking and communication but is not a party to that agreement.
termsScreen.terms5Body: Payment terms — amount, method, and timing — are arranged directly between you and the provider, unless the app states otherwise at checkout.
termsScreen.terms6Body: Either party can cancel a booking before it's confirmed. Once confirmed, cancellation terms are between you and the provider — check with them directly.
termsScreen.terms7Body: Please be respectful. We may suspend or remove accounts that engage in fraud, harassment, or unsafe behavior toward customers or providers.
termsScreen.terms8Body: Labbe is not liable for the quality, safety, or outcome of services performed by providers. We do our best to support a trustworthy marketplace, but you should use your own judgment when booking any service.
termsScreen.terms9Body: We may update these terms occasionally. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the update.
termsScreen.terms10Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
termsScreen.privacy1Body: Your name, phone number, email, and any addresses you save. If you're a provider, also your profile photo, service pricing, and availability. We also store your booking history and the messages you exchange through the app's chat.
termsScreen.privacy2Body: To connect you with providers or customers, process bookings, send you updates about your bookings, and provide support when you contact us.
termsScreen.privacy3Body: We share your name, contact details, and booking information with the other party in a booking — customer and provider — so the job can actually happen. We don't sell your data to third parties.
termsScreen.privacy4Body: Your data is stored with Google Firebase. We take reasonable steps to protect it, but no system is 100% secure.
termsScreen.privacy5Body: You can update your profile information anytime in Account Details. To delete your account or data, contact us through Help & Support.
termsScreen.privacy6Body: Questions about these terms or your data? Reach us through Help & Support in the app.
